subject: Pre-join verification transfer: background & training proofs
messages:
From: Mark Liu <mark.liu@luminahealth.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: compliance@luminahealth.com
Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: employee pre-join verification (SOC2 intake)

Hi Stephanie,

We're starting the SOC 2 intake for our upcoming integration and need a short sample and explanation of your pre-boarding controls for a random cohort of hires who joined in the last 6 months. Specifically:

- Redacted background-check evidence for 3 hires (name redacted but employee IDs or hire dates ok).
- Training attestation logs showing completion dates for security awareness and data handling.
- Onboarding access grant and deprovision timestamps for any engineers who later left (date ranges ok).

Can you provide a CSV or zipped bundle with these artifacts and a short narrative describing your redaction/PII handling process? We only need samples — no full PII.

Targeting our audit kickoff next Friday; would appreciate if you could confirm turnaround (we're ok with a staged delivery).

Thanks,
Mark Liu
Head of Security Operations
Lumina Health
mark.liu@luminahealth.com

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mark Liu <mark.liu@luminahealth.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: employee pre-join verification (SOC2 intake)

Hi Mark — thanks for the clear ask. We can do a staged delivery: initial redacted samples + training attestation CSV by EOD Thursday, and the onboarding access timeline CSV the following day.

Quick notes:
- We will provide redacted PDFs (names removed, employee IDs replaced with internal IDs) and a short PDF describing our redaction process and consent provenance.
- Training attestation will include completion timestamps and course IDs for security awareness and secure coding where applicable.
- Access logs will show grant and revoke timestamps for the cohort; we'll remove any direct network IPs and redact session tokens.

I'll pull together the artifacts and loop in Rishi and Monica to assemble the export. Is there any format you prefer for the narrative (short memo PDF vs plain text)?

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2027 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: employee pre-join verification (SOC2 intake)

Team — forwarding Lumina's ask (see below). Can you pull the artifacts for a 3-person sample from hires between Feb–Jul 2027 and prepare the following:

1) sample_bg_redacted.pdf — single-page PDF per person with redaction (DOB/SSN removed; internal employee ID present)
2) training_attestation.csv — columns: employee_id, course_id, course_name, completion_date, attest_signature (yes/no)
3) onboard_access_log.csv — columns: employee_id, resource, access_granted_at, access_revoked_at (if applicable), change_owner

Constraints: do not share raw PII. Use internal IDs only. Add a short memo (1 page) describing redaction steps and vendor used for background checks.

Rishi: can you export the access grant/revoke timestamps from IAM for the cohort? Monica: can you generate the attestation CSV and pull redacted BG scans? If there's any compliance gating, escalate to me.

Thanks —
Stephanie

Stephanie / Monica — I pulled the IAM logs and prepped the access CSV (onboard_access_log.csv). Notes:

- Export covers hires with start_date between 2027-02-01 and 2027-07-31.
- Access_granted_at and access_revoked_at fields are ISO8601 timestamps.
- We removed ephemeral session tokens, IP addresses, and any MFA device serials per the redaction checklist.
- Attached: onboard_access_log.csv (stub), sample_bg_redacted.pdf (3 PDFs merged for transit).

Monica: when you attach training_attestation.csv I'll merge and generate the memo describing redaction vendor and consent chain.

-Rishi

Attachments: [onboard_access_log.csv] [sample_bg_redacted.pdf]
